text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS). The history of severe grunting and retractions in a newborn, combined with chest X-ray findings of a "ground glass" appearance and fine reticular granulation, is classic for RDS due to surfactant deficiency.
